w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering The Focus Group gorges at the treeline — 800 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Agnese just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🔥 The fire settles. Ines has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Buffering — I put it down today." "Its telegraphs describe the FUTURE — 'it will step left.' 🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the northeast. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/14/8), with 7 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 15 · Craft 12 · Talk 14 · Explore 47 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
